# Deployer, adpeyre fork

Fork of [deployphp/deployer](https://github.com/deployphp/deployer) publishing a `deployer.phar` that includes pull requests not merged upstream yet.

The project README is [at the root](../README.md).

## Differences with Deployer

**[See commits and diff against upstream](https://github.com/adpeyre/deployer/compare/master...custom-build)**

## Branches

| Branch | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `master` | Exact copy of `deployphp/deployer` |
| `custom` | `master` + one tooling commit (this file, `build.sh`, `custom-build` workflow) |
| `custom-build` | Generated by `build.sh`: `custom` + the commits of the branches listed in the script |
| others | One branch per pull request opened upstream |

`custom-build` is rebuilt and force-pushed on every build: do not work on it.

## Building a version

```bash
git switch custom
./build.sh                    # assembles and pushes custom-build: tests run on GitHub Actions
./build.sh 8.0.5-custom.2     # same, then tags: the phar is published in a release
```

The version is based on the latest upstream tag. Phars are available in the [releases](https://github.com/adpeyre/deployer/releases).
